name: cats-effect-scala
description: Monadic Scala 3 with Cats Effect 3 and the Typelevel stack — IO, Resource, fibers, Ref/Deferred, http4s, fs2, circe, doobie. Auto-load for any Scala task using `cats.effect`, http4s, or fs2. Depends on the general `scala` plugin for language-level rules.

interface.shortDescription: Monadic Scala 3 with Cats Effect 3 and the Typelevel stack.
interface.longDescription: Cats Effect 3 and the Typelevel ecosystem — IO as a referentially transparent effect value, Resource lifecycles, fibers and structured concurrency, Ref/Deferred/Queue for shared state, plus http4s, fs2, circe, and doobie. Builds on the general `scala` plugin.
